notes.title: Small Fixes and Tweaks
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where your position when restarting a run wouldn't reset if you were repeatedly jumping during the reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked how the facing direction works to prevent bugs where player's wouldn't face the correct direction. (This should fix a bug where the yoyo wouldn't work properly.)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Optimisations and Pointer Adjustments
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the pointer would randomly appear even without any noticeable input from the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added some small optimisations to the background. (Aiming to fix the stutters that can occasionally occur when transitioning screens.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, if you encounter anymore issues feel free to reach out![/p]

notes.title: Two the Top! Out Now!
notes.content: [h3]Two the Top has now released![/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played the demo and left feedback![/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Friend Pass[/b][/u][/p][p]The game supports Friend Pass, so only one player has to own the full experience for both players to enjoy! The Demo of the game acts as the friend pass for the game, join a friend who owns the full game to experience the full thing.[/p][p][/p][p]If both players are using the friend pass edition you can still access the demo version of the game, but cannot play the full experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Matchmaking Change[/u][/b][/p][p]The Matchmaking uses a code based system where you will have to share a code with your friend to connect them to your lobby![/p][list][*][p]Added a hide code button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a copy code button. (To make communication easier!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy the game, if you encounter any problems feel free to reach out![/p]
